blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Former teammates, coaches and opponents paid tribute to Purefoods legend Peter June Simon, sharing their fondest memories of the eight-time PBA champion following his death on Friday. Tributes poured in for Simon, who grew his legend in the PBA with the Purefoods franchise before retiring in 2020. His shocking death was confirmed early Saturday.
